text:
lee_quantshop: Hey team, QuantShop ready to kick off the POC next Tue 10am PT. Want to align on scope, success metrics, and who will own each item. cc @sarah_ae @mike_se
sarah_ae: Great — putting together a proposed agenda. Who from QuantShop will join besides Lee?
mike_se: Thanks. Two quick asks up front: 1) what dataset/sample prompts can they share? 2) any hard SLA/latency or privacy requirements?
lee_quantshop: They'll have 2 product PMs + infra lead (Esther). Can share 5k anonymized chat logs and 20 canonical prompts. SLA = user-facing inference <200ms p95, acceptable batch for async scoring. Data privacy = no PHI, but must remain in EU region.
tanya_se: Perfect. For success criteria propose: 1) relevance score (embedding+Rerank) improvement vs baseline >= 10% on their eval set, 2) p95 latency <200ms for hosted flow, 3) end-to-end pipeline demo with sample prompts + logs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
sarah_ae: Add: business success metric — 20% uplift in task completion rate in a 2-week pilot with 1 internal cohort. Also need a clear cost estimate (hosted vs dedicated) for expected QPS.
jordan_security: Quick security checklist: SSO/SCIM? Data residency in EU? KMS support? SOC2 + customer NDA? Also retention policy for logs and eval artifacts.
lee_quantshop: They require SSO (SAML), EU-only data, audit logs retained 90 days, and KMS for keys. NDA in place already.
mike_se: OK — infra notes: hosted ESG will work with region=eu-west, but dedicated reserve needed if they want strict tenancy. For latency target we should test with model X-2q and quantization profile A.
infra-bot: deploybot: New staging environment reservation requested: eu-west-1, g4dnx-large, 2 instances — pending approval.
tanya_se: For evals, we'll need a golden prompt set — I'll make a 30-prompt suite: retrieval scenarios, multi-turn followups, and 5 adversarial cases. Example prompt snippet below:
```
Customer: "Find the best replacement capacitor for part 1234 with voltage >=50V and temp tolerance >85C"
System: [expected structured JSON list with sku, lead-time, confidence]
```
Keep responses structured so reranker/metrics work.
sarah_ae: Timeline suggestion: Mon 1 week — data ingestion + SSO test; Week 2 — model tuning + eval runs; Week 3 — integration demo + business metric test. Is that aggressive?
mike_se: That seems doable if QuantShop provides sample data by EOD Thu. Need a dedicated SE session for prompt engineering (2 hours) and a security walkthrough with Jordan.
jordan_security: I'll prepare a short checklist and connect with Esther for KMS/SCIM mapping. Also flag: customer needs contractual guarantee around data segregation — we'll propose Dedicated if they sign a 3mo commit.
lee_quantshop: Sounds good. They can deliver samples by Thu. Esther can join Jordan tomorrow noon. Ready to run with your agenda, will forward calendar invites.
tanya_se: Action items captured: 1) Sarah — send agenda + calendar invites, 2) Mike — plan SE prompt session + perf test plan, 3) Jordan — security checklist + call with Esther, 4) Tanya — prepare 30-prompt eval set and sample metrics dashboard. Target kickoff calendar invite sent by EOD. :rocket:
sarah_ae: I'll draft pricing options (hosted per-token vs 3mo dedicated with reserved capacity) and share numbers before kickoff. Also include expected unit cost for 1M tokens and embedding throughput.
lee_quantshop: Thanks all. Looking forward — will add Esther and QuantShop PM to the thread when she confirms.
(End of thread)
